The 10-3-2-1-0 Wind-Down Formula

10 hours before bed: no caffeine. 3 hours: no heavy meals. 2 hours: no stressful work. 1 hour: no screens. 0: number of times you hit snooze tomorrow morning.

🌡️

Thermal Vasodilation

A warm shower 60–90 minutes before sleep dilates blood vessels in your hands and feet, dumping core heat and signaling the brain that sleep is imminent.

🕯️

Circadian Light Dimming

Lower light sources to below eye level in the evening. Amber and warm dimming wavelengths protect natural melatonin synthesis from circadian disruption.

Self-Care & Mental Wellness Habits

Wellness is not a lavish reward; it is the daily maintenance of your biological and emotional equilibrium.

Daily Mindful Checklist

1 / 6 Complete

Instant Wellness Micro-Tip

Somatic Regulation

“When you feel overwhelmed, splash cold water on your forehead and cheeks. This triggers the mammalian dive reflex, immediately dropping your heart rate by 10–15 beats per minute.”

Neurobiology Tip #1

Core Mental Wellness Pillars

  • 🛡️ Compassionate Boundaries: Saying 'no' to demands that deplete you is saying 'yes' to your mental health.
  • 🥗 The Gut-Brain Connection: 90% of serotonin receptors are located in the gut. Eat whole, unrefined foods to nourish mood.
  • 🧠 Cognitive Defusion: Acknowledge: "I am having the thought that I failed," rather than "I am a failure." You are the observer of thoughts.
Educational Articles & Psychoeducation

Evidence-Based Mental Health Library

Practical tools developed with modern psychology and neurobiology to protect your mental energy.

🌙

Sleep Architecture & Wind-Down

Dim overhead lights 60 minutes before sleep. Shift from blue spectrum lighting to amber, lower room temperature to 65–68°F (18–20°C), and avoid high-arousal screens.

📵

Digital Micro-Detox

Implement "sacred mornings": protect the first 30 minutes after waking from notification overload and news doomscrolling. Reclaim your mental baseline.

🛡️

Compassionate Boundaries

“No” is a complete sentence. Protecting your capacity is not selfish; it is the prerequisite for being genuinely present for what truly matters.

🫀

The Physiological Sigh

Two quick inhales through the nose followed by one long, slow sigh through the mouth instantly collapses alveoli tension and slows cardiac tempo.

Confidential Wellbeing Check

The PHQ-4 Mental Health Screener

Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems? This brief tool provides a compassionate benchmark for anxiety and low mood.

1. Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge?

2. Not being able to stop or control worrying?

3. Little interest or pleasure in doing things?

4. Feeling down, depressed, or hopeless?

Mental Health & Wellbeing

Ministry of Health & Family Welfare / DGHS

Tele-MANAS

telemanas.mohfw.gov.in

National Tele Mental Health Programme of India. 24/7 free, confidential psychological triage, tele-counseling, and psychiatric support in 20+ languages.

📞 24/7 Helplines:
Call 14416 1800-89-14416
Open Official Website

National Mental Health Programme

dghs.mohfw.gov.in

Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) official programme providing community mental health delivery, district mental health units, and clinical infrastructure.

Open Official Website
👩‍🦰

Women’s Safety & Empowerment

Ministry of Women & Child Development / NCW

Mission Shakti

missionshakti.wcd.gov.in

National umbrella scheme for safety, security, and empowerment of women. Integrates Sambal (One-Stop Centres, Women Helpline) and Samarthya (empowerment & care).

📞 Women Helpline:
Call 181
Open Official Website

National Commission for Women

ncw.gov.in

Statutory public body safeguarding women's constitutional and legal rights, facilitating formal complaint redressal, emergency interventions, and legal support.

📞 NCW Helpline:
7827170170
Open Official Website

National Cyber Crime Portal
